$comment: Market metadata, bilingual categories/labels, and optional per-plugin overrides. Package names must match entries in plugins.txt (or packages discovered from Git repos).

description.zh: Mindeck 官方维护的插件索引。

description.en: Capture an idea in one sentence and generate complete scripts, headlines, video covers, illustrations, and storyboard line art.
description.zh: 一句话记灵感，一键成稿：口播脚本、标题、视频封面、配图与黑白线稿分镜。

description.en: Agent browser automation with 34 structured tools, built-in ego-lite runtime, live sidebar viewport with interactive mouse control, download capture, CAPTCHA handoff, and Chrome session import.
description.zh: Agent 浏览器：将浏览器自动化封装为 34 个结构化工具，内置 ego-lite 运行时；右侧栏实时观察窗（实时画面、鼠标交互、下载捕获与人机验证提醒），支持 Chrome 登录态导入。

description.en: Integrated Univer spreadsheets & documents workspace with bundled gateway and viewer: inline previews, live floating windows, and session-end review actions.
description.zh: 集成 Univer 表格与文档协同套件，内置预览网关与查看器：支持对话内联预览、悬浮协作窗口与会话结束审阅操作。

description.en: Outliner and mind-map plugin for DeepSeek Harness: edit one document as a nested outline or a live mind map, with local autosave, backups, and Markdown/OPML import and export.
description.zh: 大纲笔记与实时思维导图插件：同一份文档可在嵌套大纲与交互式脑图视图间实时切换，支持本地自动保存、备份与 Markdown/OPML 导入导出。

description.en: Windows desktop automation (Computer Use): operate native desktop apps such as CAD, WPS, browsers, and WeChat via vision and input control.
description.zh: Windows 桌面自动化：为电脑装上视觉与键鼠操作能力，支持自动操作 CAD、WPS、浏览器、微信等各类桌面软件。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop theme for the web GUI — ivory and warm-black canvases, clay accent, Claude-style model picker, permission segments, and account drawer.
description.zh: 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉主题插件——象牙白与暖黑双画布、陶烬橙强调色、Claude 风格模型选择器、权限分段与账户抽屉。
